author: Zintenka
body:
#1: Are villager trades allowed on maps? I think this would boost Avicore's popularity tenfold. 
I perfected this completely and i plan to implement it in my latest map.

The map will be called Dark Mount. 

#2: Are command blocks allowed on maps? This would also boost Avicore's popularity. 

You could push a button with a hidden command block behind it and poof! You are given experience, armor, and etc. Very versatile. I perfected this too. 

This here map has command block based teleport-pads and other functions.: https://www.mediafire.com/?2c7u6831c44zec1

#3: I know in Avicus that anvils were disabled but in the new maps i see them. Can we interact with them to add enchantments to weapons and tools?

I know that there was a problem with ppl naming them inappropriately. But those guys can be punished. 

I might plan on adding these if they are acceptable.

title: Villager Trades, command blocks, and anvils

replies.author: TemporaryBan
replies.body:
The Villagers should be allowed as long as it is done correctly maybe make them invincible and not able to be moved all that jazz also they shouldn't be to op. Also thats a really good idea!

Command blocks are allowed, there is a map with them already so i think it would be alright, ask a map dev just to make sure!

Anivls, hmmm. Im not to sure about that at all honestly, maybe ParaSpider or Evocal could post here and answer that one?

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
Villager Trades seems pretty interesting, I'd say yes.

I'm pretty sure a map called Titans had a few command blocks I had to remove because of the chat spam, but yeah, as long as they are implemented properly I guess it's good.

People might use Anvils to rename their weapons something really innapropiate, so I really would like to avoid maps with them (even though Volcano, and Para's map itself, Periculum, contain Anvils, then again, other staff members can punish players for it, so you could give it a try, but don't add to much, please...)

Good luck with your map, I'm looking forward to see it!

replies.body:
Lol. Thanks Evo. In order to got rid of the chat spam, you need to do /gamerule CommandBlockOutPut False. 

So, yeah i think i got the hang of it.
